li_projects.title: Boosting Meta’s SAM2 Model (Computer Vision Model) by 17% Using NVIDIA Research.
li_projects.description: Reimplemented core ideas from NVIDIA Research's 3AM paper (arXiv:2601.08831) independently, days after its release before any official code was public. Built a custom 2.1M-parameter attention-based fusion module (FeatureMerger) that sits between two frozen pretrained models: Meta's SAM2 (224M params) and MUSt3R (48M params), combining RGB appearance features with 3D geometric priors for more robus

li_projects.title: Voxel Engine: Built from Scratch in C++ & OpenGL
li_projects.description: Built a 3D voxel game engine inspired by Minecraft from scratch using C++ and modern OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile, no game engine. What’s implemented: - Procedural terrain generation combining layered Perlin/FBm noise with ridged-fractal noise (FastNoiseLite) to produce rolling hills and distinct mountain ranges - Dynamic chunk streaming: chunks load/unload in real time around the camera with a runtime
